svg.title: m1_culture_v1: plan view
svg.text: chip/m1_culture_v1.json · footprint 30 × 20 mm · plan view, to scale · all dimensions mm
Every chamber and channel is 0.3 mm deep: one embossing depth, a resin-printed tool hot-embossed into the layer, with the tubing ports drilled through the lid.
Small grey names are the contracts/blocks.json CAD block each chamber and channel is built from; red means it is not in the library.
Tightest clearance between unconnected features: 1.06 mm, between port 'm1_factor_2' and channel 'm1_ch_seed_3'. Planar check: no overlaps.
